sentences.en: and him telling me that I could write my generation's version of How I Met Your Mother someday.
sentences.zh: 而他告诉我，总有一天我也能写出我们这一代人的《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: Obviously, I couldn't write anything as magical as Himyam.
sentences.zh: 显然，我写不出像《老爸老妈浪漫史》那样充满魔力的作品。

sentences.en: I just wanted to make him laugh as much as Himyam made him laugh.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让他笑得像《老爸老妈浪漫史》让他笑得那样开心。

sentences.en: My father passed away in 2010, and I had just turned 11.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在2010年去世了，当时我刚满11岁。

sentences.en: School was starting back up, and my best friend at the time, and I spent our lunch reenacting scenes from Himyam,
sentences.zh: 当时正值开学，我和当时的最好朋友在午餐时间重新排演《老爸老妈浪漫史》里的场景，

sentences.en: The gang growing up and growing old together, having adventures through their 30s,
